intervention_description: Multi-faceted intervention providing livestock assets, cash stipend, skills training, savings account, healthcare access, and coaching for ultra-poor women

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Monthly cash stipend of USD 54 PPP for 12 months provided
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: Health subsidy included, with hygiene kit and medical expense reimbursement
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Livestock assets worth USD 1,136-1,488 PPP transferred
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Basic training on livestock rearing and entrepreneurship provided
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Help opening bank accounts and promoting savings behavior
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: Biweekly mentoring visits for one year
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Indicators of political involvement and social capital increased

outcomes.outcome_description: Total per capita consumption in PPP USD per month
outcomes.literal_text: Per-capita consumption increases by 30% relative to the control group
Food security index increases by 0.49 standard deviations (p-value < 0.0005)
Financial inclusion index increases by 2.38 standard deviations (FWER-corrected p-value < 0.0005)
Livestock assets index increases by 1.06 SD
Household assets index increases by 0.36 SD

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage increase in total time spent working
outcomes.literal_text: 55% increase in total time spent working of the primary woman

outcomes.outcome_description: Total monthly household income in PPP USD
outcomes.literal_text: Total monthly household income increases by USD 69 PPP (p-value 0.007) from USD 307 PPP in control group

outcomes.outcome_description: Standardized psychological well-being index for primary woman
outcomes.literal_text: Psychological well-being index increases by 0.58 SD for primary woman

outcomes.outcome_description: Standardized psychological well-being index for primary man
outcomes.literal_text: Psychological well-being index increases by 0.26 SD for primary man

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage decrease in diarrhea rate for children under five
outcomes.literal_text: Diarrhea rate in children under five falls by 16%
